svg.title: Health app SDLC — corrected 6-phase development order
svg.desc: Six-phase development flow: data pipeline, discretisation, DBN training, runtime inference engine (no UI), agentic layer, then React Native UI, then integration test and user study.

g.text: Phase 0 — data
Phase 1 — disc.
Phase 2 — DBN
Phase 3 — runtime
Phase 4 — agentic
Phase 5 — UI
Phase 6
Three datasets in
StudentLife (primary) · LifeSnaps (secondary) · NHANES (priors only)
Clean · uid train/val split 80/20 (seed 42) · winsorise · z-score
Fix sleep_hours broadcast first · fix LifeSnaps age join first · split before thresholds
Distribution overlap check · harmonise columns · NHANES prior JSON
Gate: no state below 10% · thresholds saved
K-Means discretisation (k=3) · fit on train uids only
Clinical thresholds (PHQ, PSS, BMI) · K-Means for sensors · class balance audit
Apply to full CSV · save boundaries to feature_node_config.json
Gate: no state below 10% · thresholds reproducible on val set
Expert knowledge
Forced · forbidden edges · startup validation
Likelihood tables
P(bin|state) per node · soft E-step evidence
Phased Structural EM (Phase 1→2→3)
_sanitize · _hard_kick · _perturb · LBP E-step · HillClimbSearch M-step
CPT spread → HIGH_WEIGHT_NODES · visualize_bn · cross-population validation
Gate: val log-likelihood passes · no isolated nodes · visualize_bn confirms graph
FastAPI /query_dbn · SQLite schema · evidence fusion
Tested via direct API calls and scripted evidence dicts — no UI
SLM pipeline · intent router · NER · gates · delta · confidence
Prompt templates · session state · alert checker · proactive node check
Background task manager · chat trigger · notification logic · doctor brief
Timer + chat triggers tested via scripted sensor simulation
Gate: 7-day simulated data · both triggers · intent router 30-utterance eval
On-device vector store
ONNX embedding model · UserMemory · dedup
Phi-3 Mini loaded
RAM budget confirmed alongside smaller SLM
ReAct agent + reflection loop + plan-and-execute (Phi-3 Mini)
Tools: query_dbn · get_user_history · get_user_memory · get_trend
Gate: scripted agentic test · reflection catches overclaiming · no health data leaves device
React Native Expo scaffold
expo-health · expo-sqlite · expo-notifications · react-native-llama.cpp
Dashboard · chat · onboarding · notifications · doctor brief export
Wired against complete backend — one time, correct from day one
Gate: full stack smoke test — sensor → DBN → agent → UI end-to-end
Integration test + user study (final system)
7-day simulated data · 60-utterance SLM eval · 3+ users · SUS · insight ratings
